Tell someone about a great movie you saw and they might mention it once. Tell them it was terrible and they'll bring it up for a week.

Negativity spreads faster than positivity, every time, which is exactly why news is built the way it is. Almost any story could be reported neutrally, sometimes even positively. It doesn't get reported that way, because negative sells and positive doesn't.

There's an old word for people especially wired for this: a "snipe," susceptible to the negative influence of other people. Most people today are one, whether they know it or not.
